title: Turkey & Spinach Stuffed Baked Potatoes
description: Fluffy baked potatoes filled with seasoned ground turkey, spinach, and cheese.
substitutions: Use black beans instead of turkey.
Use frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry.

steps.text: Split potatoes and fill with turkey mixture and cheese.

cookSteps.text: Cook 4 russet potatoes until very tender: microwave individually or together according to size, or bake at 425°F for about 45–60 minutes.
While the potatoes cook, brown 1/2 pound ground turkey in a skillet with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, about 7–8 minutes, until fully cooked.
Add 2 cups spinach and stir 1–2 minutes until wilted.
Split the hot potatoes, fluff the centers, and divide the turkey-spinach mixture among them. Top with 1/2 cup shredded cheddar and yogurt or sour cream if using.

storage: Refrigerate assembled potatoes up to 3 days.

title: One-Pan Tomato Bean Polenta
description: Creamy quick polenta topped with saucy white beans and tomatoes.
substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Skip parmesan for a dairy-free meal.

steps.text: Warm beans and tomatoes with seasoning.

cookSteps.text: Bring 4 cups water or broth to a boil. Slowly whisk in 1 cup quick-cooking polenta.
Reduce heat and cook according to the package, usually 5–8 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in 1/2 cup parmesan if using, then scrape the polenta into bowls.
In the same pan, combine 1 can drained white beans, 1 can diced tomatoes, and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning. Simmer 8 minutes.
Spoon the tomato-bean mixture over the polenta.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; loosen polenta with a splash of water when reheating.

title: Banana Peanut Butter Baked Oats
description: Soft baked oatmeal with banana and peanut butter, good for breakfast or a simple snack.
substitutions: Use sunflower-seed butter for a peanut-free version.

steps.text: Heat oven and grease a small baking dish.
Mix all ingredients and spread in dish.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Mix 2 cups oats, 2 mashed bananas, 1 1/2 cups milk, 1/4 cup peanut butter, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and 1 teaspoon baking powder. Spread in the dish.
Bake 23–25 minutes until the center is set.

title: Quick Cabbage Egg Drop Soup
description: A light, fast soup with tender cabbage and ribbons of egg.
substitutions: Use baby spinach in place of some cabbage.
Add leftover cooked rice for a heartier bowl.

cookSteps.text: Bring 4 cups broth, 3 cups sliced cabbage, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1/4 teaspoon ginger if using to a simmer.
Simmer 6–7 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Beat 2 eggs with a fork. Slowly drizzle them into the simmering soup while stirring gently to make ribbons.
Cook 1 more minute, then top with 2 sliced scallions if using.
